issues.description: Users cannot log in because their account appears hacked, and support channels are not resolving the access problem.
issues.name: Account hacked and locked out

issues.description: Users report the app stops working, logs them out, or refuses to open or accept their phone number after updates.
issues.name: General app access failures

issues.description: Users are logged out unexpectedly or cannot sign in to their existing accounts despite trying.
issues.name: Unable to log in

issues.description: Users cannot log in even after resetting their password, with incorrect password errors persisting.
issues.name: Login fails despite password reset

issues.description: New users cannot complete account sign-up, getting errors or repeated prompts instead of a working account.
issues.name: Cannot create or sign up

issues.description: Users are charged after cancelling or cannot complete payment, and report being left without working access.
issues.name: Charged after cancelling or unable to pay

issues.description: Users report being pushed toward premium, failing to pay in-app with "unable to connect" errors, and losing basic playback without a subscription.
issues.name: Payment and paywall frustrations

issues.description: Free users find core playback features restricted and heavy ads, while paid users sometimes see inconsistent subscription status.
issues.name: Free tier features locked behind premium

issues.description: Users feel the premium subscription is too expensive for the value, especially alongside ads and bugs.
issues.name: Premium price seen as too high

issues.description: Users lose family or premium plans after changing payment details, or cannot start an individual subscription.
issues.name: Subscription changes cause access loss

issues.description: Users report wrong songs playing, search results missing or mismatched, and restricted artist catalogues.
issues.name: Song selection and matching errors

issues.description: Users report that lyrics fail to load or have disappeared from songs they play.
issues.name: Lyrics not loading or missing

issues.description: Users find songs, specials, or features that were previously available have been removed or are unavailable in their region.
issues.name: Songs and shows unavailable

issues.description: Users report missing podcast history, unavailable audiobooks or video podcasts, and podcast playback problems.
issues.name: Podcast and audiobook gaps

issues.description: Users say the app plays recommended songs instead of the playlists they selected, and offline playback of downloads stalls.
issues.name: Recommendations override chosen playlists

issues.description: Users cannot find songs or artists through search, which often shows no results or fails to load.
issues.name: Search returns nothing

issues.description: Users cannot download music, or downloads fail to save to storage or require a subscription first.
issues.name: Downloads fail or won't save

issues.description: Users find their downloaded songs and playlists gone after updates or time passing, with no fix from support.
issues.name: Downloaded music vanishes

issues.description: Users have trouble adding local files, saving to SD cards, and syncing playlists across devices.
issues.name: Local files and storage problems

issues.description: Users find downloaded music will not play offline, or offline mode times out or disappears entirely.
issues.name: Offline playback fails

issues.description: Users report the app stopped working or was compromised, with vague complaints not tied to a specific feature.
issues.name: Miscellaneous app breakdowns

issues.description: Users hear no sound from music, distorted or low-quality audio, or volume problems while other apps work fine.
issues.name: No sound or poor audio quality

issues.description: The app fails to launch even after clearing cache, drains battery, or uses excessive storage and background data.
issues.name: Launch failures and heavy resource use

issues.description: Users see "no internet connection" messages or endless loading even when their network and other apps work fine.
issues.name: False no-internet errors

issues.description: Users report the app crashing repeatedly, closing unexpectedly, or refusing to open after updates.
issues.name: App crashes or won't open

issues.description: Users report music will not play or load, sometimes requiring reinstalls, with no clear cause.
issues.name: Playback fails to start

issues.description: The app loads slowly or freezes on a logo or black screen, and songs or playlists take ages to start.
issues.name: Slow loading and stuck screens

issues.description: Songs stop randomly, cannot be skipped, or exit the app during playback, particularly after updates.
issues.name: Playback stops unexpectedly

issues.description: Users find customer support unhelpful, slow to respond, or stuck in loops, and report problems with support features like email.
issues.name: Support is slow or unhelpful

issues.description: Free users face frequent ads, including ads mid-song, and limited listening time before ads resume.
issues.name: Ads interrupt free listening

issues.description: Users encounter blank screens, awkward navigation, and playback that does not match what they tapped.
issues.name: Navigation and display glitches

issues.description: Users find playlists stop after one song, skip to unrelated music, or fail to show their chosen tracks and genres.
issues.name: Playlists play wrong or stop

issues.description: Users cannot skip, rewind, or choose songs freely, and shuffle or car mode changes make controls harder to use.
issues.name: Shuffle and skip controls restricted

issues.description: Users say the redesigned interface is hard to use or crashes the app, and they want the earlier design back.
issues.name: Disliked new interface design

membership_rule: one issue per completed complaint/cancellation record: topic + first matching keyword subtopic, else general
